en-US.name: Tianyancha Risk Query
en-US.summary: Enterprise risk profile by company name — self/related/historical/warning risk
en-US.description: Tianyancha enterprise risk query — input a company name and return a structured risk profile (self risk / related-party risk / historical risk / early warnings, with category counts and details). Use when the user asks about enterprise risk, judicial risk, litigation announcements, court rulings, dishonest debtors, or Tianyancha.
